note: The index over this repository's AGENTS.md: each rule quotes its guide's line and is read by it; accepted with the author's OK.

rules.text: the reader sees only what privacy lists
quote: The reader sees only what `docs/privacy.md` lists: never the session (the prompts, Claude's replies) or code beyond the change. Secrets are refused; a training tier reads nothing until the project allows it, and from a repository not confirmed public it reads labels only.

rules.text: a refused or failed reading is never a pass
quote: A refused or failed reading is never a pass.
Plan mode stays Claude Code's: a plan is read only to inform.
Shadow mode blocks nothing, and its reads run in the background; enforce mode asks before the user's acts and sends Claude back on a ▲.

rules.text: frame 0, rules, tree and switch change only with the user
quote: Frame 0, the rules, the tree and the switch change only with the user: Claude writing any of them rises to the user.
The user reads plain words: no JSON, ids or internal terms; "requirement", never "ask".

rules.text: a behavior change comes with a test
quote: Behavior change: a test that fails on the old code, then the suite twice; band changes also `claude plugin test .`.

Docs: README brief, details in `docs/`; docs-only changes need link and fact checks, not a full test run. Shape: top-level sections are `###` headings under a `---` rule, since GitHub underlines `#` and `##`; section leads of two or three sentences at most; tables only for tabular data, run-in lists otherwise; explanation before a code block, no comments inside; at most one alert per section; each link once per page.

rules.text: docs describe the tool in the reader's terms
quote: Docs voice: the docs describe the tool, in the third person and in the reader's terms; steps are imperatives; no sentence that carries no load.

rules.text: figures in nested frames, contrast checked
quote: Figures: SVG in nested frames, as in Gadfly's paper, light and dark, every colour checked for contrast against its box; no more than two charts on a page.
Commits: a Conventional Commits subject of at most 72 characters, a blank line, then a body hard-wrapped at 72. Messages stay objective and about this project.

rules.text: docs call the work shared, not Claude's
quote: The work is the user's and Claude's together: the docs say "the work" or "the change", never "Claude's work"; Claude's replies and plans stay Claude's.
